cast.title: Searching for Bobby Fischer
cast.overview: A seven-year-old chess prodigy refuses to harden himself in order to become a champion like the famous but unlikable Bobby Fischer.

cast.title: Journey
cast.overview: Deserted by their mother, a young boy and his sister discover the true meaning of family while living with their grandfather.

cast.title: Fluke
cast.overview: Workaholic Thomas Johnson dies in an auto accident and reincarnates as a dog. Remembering some of his previous being, he returns to his wife and son to protect them from the man who caused his accident. But, as time goes by, his memories return, and Thomas realizes he wasn't such a good husband and father.

cast.title: Definitely, Maybe
cast.overview: When Will decides to tell his daughter the story of how he met her mother, he discovers that a second look at the past might also give him a second chance at the future.

cast.title: Nowhere to Hide
cast.overview: Divorcee learns from the FBI that her husband has mafia connections and put a contract on her life. She gets into the witness protection program and falls in love with the agent who protects her.
